title: Free family days out around Hobart
intro: A simple museum-and-playground day, plus weekend market browsing, without an admission-ticket budget.

sections.title: Start with a free indoor stop
sections.text: TMAG combines art, natural history and Tasmanian stories near the waterfront. General entry is free. Check the visitor page for current opening days and any separately booked activities.

sections.title: Add a playground picnic
sections.text: Princes Park in Battery Point has a playground. Pack lunch and choose a settled-weather break here; use the council page to check facilities and location.

sections.title: Browse a weekend market
sections.text: Choose Salamanca on Saturday or Farm Gate on Sunday. Browsing can be the outing; purchases and meals are optional extras. Check each listing’s organiser link for changes.

tip: Plan food, transport and parking separately from admission. For more options, browse the free and kids collections.

title: Rainy-day activities in Tasmania
intro: Choose a museum or gallery as the anchor for a wet-weather day, with practical details checked against the venue.

sections.title: Hobart: Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery
sections.text: TMAG provides an indoor mix of art, heritage and natural history with free general entry. Check seasonal opening days before setting out.

sections.title: Launceston: choose one QVMAG site
sections.text: The Museum at Inveresk and Art Gallery at Royal Park are separate destinations. Both have free general admission; the planetarium and selected programs cost extra. Pick a site first so you arrive at the right address.

sections.title: Find an indoor option in another region
sections.text: Use the rainy-day collection to filter by region and find more options. Read the individual listing and venue website for admission, bookings and opening details rather than assuming every indoor attraction is free.

tip: Choose one main indoor stop and check its access information. Leave outdoor extras flexible when the forecast changes.

title: Tasmanian markets this weekend
intro: Published market schedules and dated market events for the coming Saturday and Sunday, all in one place.

sections.title: Choose a market that actually falls this weekend
sections.text: Weekly, monthly and seasonal markets follow different patterns. The list below expands published schedules, honours excluded months and uses explicit dates for irregular markets.

sections.title: Plan a market outing
sections.text: Pick a region, check the time and address, and leave space for a second local stop. A produce market and a makers’ market offer different browsing opportunities; individual listings describe each market.

tip: These are scheduled dates, not a live cancellation service. Check the linked organiser before travelling; markets without a sourced schedule are not assigned guessed dates.
